answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. This creates a digital mirror of economic risk, forcing an attacker to acquire a majority of total supply, a feat as rare as finding an opal in the deep sea. By demanding collateral, the protocol ensures that even a massive network harbor cannot be compromised without the adversary incurring catastrophic financial ruin, effectively aligning agent incentives with network security.
